notes.morrissey-hall: OSM has no Morrissey building by name; pinned at the centre of the Morrissey Hall outline (also known as Morrissey Manor) on Notre Dame's own campus map (map.nd.edu/placemarks.json, placemark 88), between OSM's Lyons Hall and Howard Hall.
notes.oneill-family-hall: OSM's 'O'Neill Hall' dormitory (way/76245842), on West Quad between Keough and McGlinn; map.nd.edu's O'Neill Family Hall outline (placemark 109) covers the same spot. The other OSM 'O'Neill Hall' is the music building.
